thread:
nancy: Heads-up: Prospect HelioCare wants a short presales pack for their SOC/end-to-end DD. Main asks: strict EU compute, BYOK (prefer HSM-backed), list of subprocessors per region, and deletion/audit proof. Meeting tomorrow at 10.

diego-se: Can we confirm EU compute regions we can guarantee for hosted customers? They asked for eu-north-1 + eu-west-1.

kelly-ops: Hosted: we offer tenant pinning to eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 today. eu-north-1 is not on the standard footprint, requires Dedicated or Private.

nancy: Ok, we'll flag eu-north as "requires Dedicated/Private". Also they asked for HSM-backed BYOK. What's supported?

kelly-ops: Short: HSM-backed customer keys are supported on Private deployments. For Hosted we provide partner-KMS key-wrapping (software KMS) with attestation for select customers; HSM BYOK on Hosted is not available.

diego-se: Prospect will push back. Can we provide a migration path from Hosted+wrapped to Dedicated+HSM? Any downtime?

kelly-ops: Migration path: live rebind supported for stateless workloads; for models with KV cache we recommend a short maintenance window (few minutes) to warm caches after move. We'll document steps.

nancy: Subprocessor list per region? Legal needs it for questionnaire.

ryan-legal: I can add attestation once we have the region list and partner names. Please include infra providers, telemetry vendors, and KMS partners.

kelly-ops: For EU regions the primary subprocessors are: AWS (eu-west-1, eu-central-1), CloudNet telemetry (eu monitoring), KeyWrap Partners Inc (KMS wrapping in eu-central). For APAC (if asked): CloudEdge (ap-southeast-1 beta).

nancy: Can you give me the exact wording for the questionnaire entry about subprocessors?

ryan-legal: Draft: "Redwood Inference engages subprocessors necessary to deliver the service (cloud provider, telemetry, KMS partners). A complete list of subprocessors and their applicable regions is provided in the attached Subprocessor Addendum. Redwood provides 30 days' notice for new subprocessors and an opt-out for material changes."

nancy: Perfect. They also want "proof of egress path" and IP ranges for network allowlisting.

kelly-ops: Provide these CIDRs for the EU hosted frontends and egress gateways:
```
EU Frontend: 34.248.0.0/15
EU Egress: 44.55.128.0/17
KMS partner endpoints: 3.120.45.0/24
```

nancy: Great. Need a short entry about data deletion and audit logs.

ryan-legal: For questionnaire: "Customers may request data deletion which triggers a deletion workflow; audit logs recording deletion activities are retained for 90 days by default and available on request for export. For Dedicated/Private customers, retention policies can be customized per SOW."

nancy: Pricing: HelioCare wants incremental pricing for Dedicated with HSM vs Hosted pinned EU. Any ballpark numbers for presales?

kelly-ops: Ballpark: Hosted EU-pin: list price * 1.25 (isolation uplift). Dedicated (reserved monthly) approx 2.8x per throughput unit. Onboarding for BYOK HSM: one-time $15k engineering + potential HSM provider fees. Mention that final numbers require capacity profile.

diego-se: I'll surface those as "indicative" and add a note: "final pricing subject to usage profile and SOW."

deploy-bot: DEPLOY: region eu-central KMS attestation checklist created - ticket INF-9022

nancy: One last item: they want a short "what happens on capacity exhaustion" blurb.

kelly-ops: Blurb: "For hosted EU-pinned tenants on non-reserved tiers, if regional capacity is constrained requests may be queued or momentarily throttled; automated failover to another EU pinned region may occur only if customer has enabled cross-region failover. Dedicated tenants have reserved capacity and will not be failed over under normal operations."

nancy: Thanks. I'll assemble a 2-page presales pack: 1 page of attested bullets (subprocessors, CIDRs, deletion, HSM availability), + 1 page of indicative pricing + migration notes. Ryan, can you sign off on the legal bullets by EOD?

ryan-legal: Yep, I'll review and attach the Subprocessor Addendum.

nancy: Excellent — meeting tomorrow at 10. I'll upload the pack to the deal room. :thumbsup:
